reasons.claim: No threatened (CR/EN/VU) species and no eligible species recorded within 1000 m. Only two NT species appear: Poecile montanus (mobile bird, 365 m) and Crepis tectorum (not forest-associated, 830 m).
Effort around the site (101 records, 95 species, 64th percentile) is above the county median of 66. No records fall inside the polygon or within 250 m.
Completed felling overlaps 4.6% of the polygon (0.81 ha, from 2017 and 2026), below the 50% threshold.

uncertainties: Records are from only 3 observation days, so coverage of the site itself is thin.
The 1000 m effort figure is not evidence about the polygon. Near-site records are 0 inside and 0 within 250 m, which is consistent with the county median of 3 within 250 m only loosely.
not_established: Absence of red-listed or sensitive species on the site; absence of records is not absence of species.
Stand character or age; no tool output describes it.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer may do a light check of the stand with imagery or inventory data. Note that the 2026 partial felling overlap of 0.49 ha is minor.
